name: Arrays_Strings
invariant: Iterate with indices; array gives random-access O(1)

name: Two_Pointers
invariant: Two indices converge; invariant maintained between them
template_code: l=0|r=len(arr)-1|while l<r: adjust l or r

name: Sliding_Window
invariant: Window [l r] always satisfies condition; shrink when violated
template_code: l=0|for r in range(n): expand|while invalid: shrink l

name: Prefix_Sum
template_code: prefix=[0]*(n+1)|for i x in enumerate(arr): prefix[i+1]=prefix[i]+x

name: Binary_Search
invariant: Search space halves; lo/hi bracket the answer
template_code: lo=0|hi=n-1|while lo<=hi: mid=(lo+hi)//2; branch on condition

name: Hashing
invariant: Trade space for O(1) lookup; complement or count stored in map
template_code: seen={}|for x in arr: if complement in seen: found; else seen[x]=val

name: Stacks_Queues
invariant: LIFO/FIFO discipline; element retained only until needed
template_code: stack=[]|for x in arr: while stack and condition: stack.pop()|stack.append(x)

name: Monotonic_Stack
invariant: Stack stays monotone; elements pop when a larger/smaller arrives
template_code: stack=[]|for i x in enumerate(arr): while stack and arr[stack[-1]]<x: pop and compute|stack.append(i)

name: Linked_Lists
invariant: Traverse by following .next; dummy head simplifies edge cases

name: Fast_Slow_Pointers
invariant: Fast moves 2x; they meet iff a cycle exists
template_code: slow=fast=head|while fast and fast.next: slow=slow.next; fast=fast.next.next
complexity_signature: O(n) time O(1) space vs O(n) visited set

name: Trees_DFS
template_code: def dfs(node):|  if not node: return base|  l=dfs(node.left); r=dfs(node.right)|  return combine(l r node.val)

name: Trees_BFS
invariant: Process level-by-level; queue holds current frontier
template_code: from collections import deque|q=deque([root])|while q: for _ in range(len(q)): node=q.popleft(); expand
complexity_signature: O(n) time O(w) space w=max width

name: Heaps
invariant: Heap invariant: parent<=children (min-heap); O(log n) push/pop
complexity_signature: O(n log k) for top-k vs O(n log n) sort

name: Backtracking
invariant: Build candidate incrementally; prune when constraint violated
template_code: def bt(start path):|  if done: results.append(path[:]); return|  for i in range(start n): path.append(i); bt(i+1 path); path.pop()

name: Graphs
invariant: BFS/DFS from source; visited set prevents reprocessing
template_code: graph=defaultdict(list)|visited=set()|def dfs(u): visited.add(u)|  for v in graph[u]: if v not in visited: dfs(v)

name: Union_Find
invariant: parent[x]=representative; union by rank + path compression
template_code: parent=list(range(n))|def find(x): if parent[x]!=x: parent[x]=find(parent[x]); return parent[x]|def union(x y): parent[find(x)]=find(y)

name: Dynamic_Programming
invariant: dp[i]=optimal for subproblem i; built bottom-up from smaller subproblems
template_code: dp=[base]*(n+1)|for i in range(1 n+1): dp[i]=min/max over transitions from dp[j<i]
complexity_signature: O(2^n) -> O(n^2) or O(n) by state

name: Greedy
invariant: Locally optimal choice is globally optimal; proved by exchange argument
template_code: arr.sort(key=lambda x: criterion(x))|for x in arr: if feasible(x): take(x)
complexity_signature: O(n log n) sort + O(n) scan
